project: AI Sports Performance, Talent & Coaching Platform

source.license_note: Use according to StatsBomb Open Data terms; credit StatsBomb and use their logo when publishing/sharing analysis.

freeze_policy.rule: The V1 model-training/evaluation population is frozen to the competition-season records below.
freeze_policy.future_data: Any later StatsBomb updates or additional competitions require a new dataset version and must not silently alter V1 experiments.

important_limitations: This is an international-tournament dataset, not a worldwide club-league database.
Player observations are affected by national-team selection and tournament minutes.
360 data is available only for selected competitions/seasons; V1 core features must not require 360 coverage.
The dataset does not provide a validated future-success target, so V1 talent identification is a statistical shortlist, not a future-career predictor.
Physical performance metrics such as true running speed, acceleration, and distance are not available as direct player-tracking measurements in the core event data.
Longitudinal analysis is valid only for players with repeated observations across comparable tournaments; sparse or incomparable cases will be marked accordingly.
